name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
blurb: Goldman Sachs is a leading global financial institution offering investment banking, securities, asset management, and wealth management services to corporations, governments, and individuals. It operates through three segments: Global Banking & Markets, Asset & Wealth Management, and Platform Solutions. The firm is a dominant player in M&A advisory, trading, and underwriting, with a strong presence in the Americas, Europe, and Asia.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, GS shares closed at $937.35, up 2.01% on the day, with a market cap of $287.39B. The stock has rallied over 70% in the past year, reaching a 52-week high of $984.70.
